THREE REASONS IT IS ALREADY BEHIND, all of them dating from after it was published:
1. The title card reads 'Kambugriva the Tortoise'. The app has retitled the story to
'The Tortoise Who Had to Have the Last Word', and the card has been re-rendered here
but not in any published film. If this cut is live on the channel under the old name,
the channel is showing a story the app no longer has -- docs/01 §6.
2. It carries the callout font fault: bubbles in Georgia, not the app's Fraunces.
3. Its hook and moral are the pre-re-narration audio. 86.63s measured against 86.07s
expected today, and those two clips are where the difference is.
